name: flow-browser
description: A calm, private, and focused desktop browser by Tieddr.
author: Flowr Browser Team

scripts.test: node tests/adblock.test.js && node tests/adaptive-adblock.test.js && node tests/site-apps.test.js && node tests/updater.test.js && node tests/importer.test.js && node tests/privacy.test.js && node tests/navigation.test.js && node tests/account-session.test.js && node tests/browser-identity.test.js && node tests/site-downloads.test.js && node tests/startup-package.test.js && node tests/vault-pin.test.js && node tests/security.test.js && node tests/themes.test.js && node tests/store.test.js
scripts.lint:site: node --check site/public/app.js && node --check site/public/auth-config.js && node --check site/public/store/store.js && node --check site/public/store/item.js && node --check site/scripts/submit-indexnow.mjs && node --check site/scripts/check-download-config.mjs
scripts.lint:main: node --check src/main/main.js && node --check src/main/preload.js && node --check src/main/viewpreload.js && node --check src/main/store.js && node --check src/main/paths.js && node --check src/main/crx.js && node --check src/main/updater.js && node --check src/main/adblock.js && node --check src/main/privacy.js && node --check src/main/importer.js && node --check src/main/site-apps.js && node --check src/main/browser-identity.js && node --check src/shared/theme-settings.js
scripts.lint: npm run lint:main && npm run lint:site
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:site:seo
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run preflight && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win:update: npm run build && npm run preflight -- windows && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run preflight -- linux && electron-builder --linux AppImage tar.gz --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:all: npm run build && npm run preflight -- mac && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run build && npm run preflight -- mac && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run build && npm run preflight -- mac && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never

linux.synopsis: A calmer, private browser by Tieddr
